# Ceylan Hukuk Bürosu - Full Information

## Overview
Ceylan Law Office (Ceylan Hukuk Bürosu) is a professional law firm established in 1987, with offices in both Antalya and Istanbul, Turkey. The firm provides comprehensive legal services across multiple practice areas with a multilingual team serving clients in Turkish, English, German, Russian, and Arabic.

## Detailed Practice Areas

### Commercial and Corporate Law
Expert legal counsel for businesses including company formation (LLC, Joint Stock Company), mergers and acquisitions, commercial contracts, corporate governance, and commercial dispute resolution.

### Real Estate Law
Comprehensive real estate legal services including property purchase by foreign nationals, title deed procedures, real estate investment for Turkish citizenship (minimum $400,000 USD), zoning disputes, lease agreements, and property development law.

### Citizenship Law
Full-service citizenship application support including:
- Citizenship by real estate investment ($400,000+ USD)
- Citizenship by capital investment ($500,000+ USD)
- Citizenship by employment creation (50+ jobs)
- Citizenship by bank deposit ($500,000+ USD for 3 years)
- General application after 5 years of residence
- Citizenship through marriage (3+ years)

### Family and Inheritance Law
Sensitive handling of family matters including contested and uncontested divorce, alimony (interim, child support, poverty alimony), child custody, property division under community property regime, inheritance disputes, and prenuptial agreements.

### Trademark and Patent Law
Intellectual property protection including trademark registration, patent applications, brand protection strategies, licensing agreements, and IP dispute resolution.

### Bankruptcy and Enforcement Law
Debt collection and insolvency services including enforcement proceedings (with and without court orders), negotiable instrument enforcement, preliminary attachment, concordat proceedings, and bankruptcy procedures.

### Maritime Commercial Law
Legal services for maritime sector including shipping disputes, charter party agreements, maritime insurance, and port operations.

### Labor Law
Employment law services including labor contract drafting, termination disputes, severance pay calculations, workplace accident claims, and collective bargaining.
